description: What the person logged in the app: food with calories, macros and fruit and veg portions, drinks by kind (coffee, water, alcohol...), and typed weight. Each entry carries its time and part of day: morning, midday, evening or late. For a day's totals, use query_metrics.

client.description: For a coach: a client id from list_clients, to read that client. Omitted: your own account.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous page, to continue.

from.description: First day, inclusive. Omitted: six days before `to`, so the last seven days only. Pass it for anything longer, up to 366 days per call.

to.description: Last day, inclusive. Omitted: today in the account time zone.

name: query_logs
title: Query food, drink and weight logs
